weeks.note: RE-ENTRY. Vertical jump stays depressed ~18 days after an ultra, so this is easy running and nothing else. Durability is the through-line of the whole block: long sessions over 90 min are what preserve running economy under fatigue, which is the 70.3 run leg in one sentence.

sessions.label: Long easy run 6 km, HR under 155. Aerobic base is the lever - the fastest runners get there on Zone 1 volume.
Swim 30 min - TECHNIQUE ONLY. Breathing, body position, catch. Distance is irrelevant for six weeks.
Easy 6 km, talk test. Warm up 15 min + strides finishing AT goal pace and no faster.
BIKE 30 min - sweet spot, 3 x 10-12 min at 88-93% FTP (~132-140 W), 5 min easy between. The 90 km bike is over half a 70.3 by time.
SWIM LESSON (1-on-1, 45 min). Book 6-10 of these - highest-ROI line item in the whole season. You cannot self-coach a catch you have never felt.

Strength LOWER - HEAVY, 45 min. Trap-bar deadlift 4 x 3 at 88-92% 1RM (from 85 x 5 at 2 RIR your 1RM is ~105 kg, so work at 92-97 kg - autoregulate, add 2.5 kg when the last triple moves well). Then Bulgarian split squat 3 x 5/leg heavy, and calf raises 3 x 8 loaded. COMPLEX PAIRING: after each heavy set, 5 box jumps or 20 m of bounds within 2 min - heavy resistance plus plyo beats either alone for running economy. Heavy loads at or above 90% 1RM give greater economy gains than lighter ones, and the effect needs 10-14 weeks, which is exactly this block. LOWER-LEG AND FOOT, 5 min: tibialis anterior raises 3 x 15-20, heel walks 2 x 20 m, eccentric dorsiflexion 3 x 10, short-foot holds 3 x 30 s per side.

Strength UPPER - push and pull as one session, 45 min. Rows, pull-ups, overhead press, rear delts. Heavy, 4-6 reps, not hypertrophy ranges. Free against the running and cycling load. Dead hangs 3 x max at the end - grip is a genuine weakness at 32-36 s.
